run_download_co3d_dataset: run the CLI script to download the CO3D dataset with configurable categories and worker counts
run_download_single_sequence_subset: run the CLI script with --single_sequence_subset to download only the single-sequence subset of CO3D
run_download_with_checksum_check: run the CLI script with --checksum_check to validate SHA256 checksums of downloaded archives
run_download_specific_categories: run the CLI script with --download_categories to download only specific CO3D dataset categories
run_download_with_redownload: run the CLI script with --redownload_existing_archives to force re-downloading already downloaded archives
